acceptanceCriteria: Range impact over a .rb change in a repo with no proved Ruby runner reports the same verification-unknown line as path impact, covered by a test
An NGI-V0 requirement is added or amended; spec-requirements-check and focused contextindex tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1804 (PR #1145, NGI-V0-051). rangeVerification replaces coverage uncertainty, so when a --base range admits .rb paths but no RSpec or Minitest runner is proved, the range receipt names no verification unknown. Path impact over the same files says verification is unknown. Expected: the range receipt keeps the same unknown-language line as path impact. Observed in PR #1145 head 8cb4a7c1b, 2026-10-18.
title: Range impact over a Ruby range with no proved suite drops the unknown-verification line that path impact reports
